correctness.rationale: Splitting 2-space W must complement TV, uniquely parameterized by 4d-4 coefficients. The source explicit module automorphism with diagonal-unit images sends W to span{e1, P e1+e2}, P uniform t-divisible long-block polynomial. Eliminating Krylov columns leaves r×r Hankel (b_{1+i+j}) for r>=1. Dwivedi–Grinberg Theorem 1.1 gives exactly q^{2r-2} singular out of q^{2r-1}, yielding success fraction 1-1/q and count (q-1)q^{4d-5}. Balanced r=0 follows from module Nakayama. Independently counted nonsingular Hankel matrices for q=2,3 and r<=3 from all coefficient tuples; full d,q theorem relies on algebra and cited Hankel theorem, not finite range.
